articles.title: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token
articles.snippet: Backed by BBVA, BNP Paribas, and ING, Qivalis secured Dutch regulatory authorization to offer onchain euro settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: Proposed 31.4% French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
articles.snippet: Chainalysis' regional sales director in France Francois Volpoet warned the proposed 31.4% tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders toward unmonitored offshore channels.

articles.title: Standard Chartered unlocks direct bitcoin and ether trading for affluent UAE clients
articles.snippet: The bank manages custody and settlement in-house via a closed-loop model, removing the need for separate crypto wallets.

articles.title: Largest Philippines crypto exchange, Coins.ph, said to face central bank regulatory action
articles.snippet: The exchange, which has over 18 million customers, is said to have handled business transactions involving restricted offshore gaming and gambling companies.

articles.title: Strive raising $500 million to buy additional bitcoin with new preferred share class
articles.snippet: SATS will offer a fixed 15% dividend yield at par and be junior to the company's existing SATA, which pays a variable rate (currently 13%).
